blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick a Door

items.text: Before you commit, check your fit, your situation, the job market and AI-proofing.
Can you sit for long drawing and design sessions, a slow research ladder, a uniform and a barracks, or months at sea.
A door you respect but dread at 7 a.m. will not survive year two.

blocks.heading: Headroom, and What Caps the Rest

items.text: Several doors here have two hard filters: getting in, then getting the first strong placement, licence or rank.
A strong design portfolio or a real data project can earn work before you graduate, and the ceiling is set by proof, not by a pay band.
Best for: students who will build visible work every week.

blocks.heading: Popular Claims Vs the Official Notice
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Popular claims vs the official notice

rows: "NDA age is 16 to 19."
The rule is a birth-date window, not a rounded age. NDA II 2026 used 2 Jan 2008 to 1 Jan 2011, about 16.5 to 19.5 years at the exam.
"NATA needs 50% in Class 12."
The NATA 2026 brochure states at least 45% in aggregate, and Maths is compulsory. Older pages still repeat 50%.
"UCEED is held at five IITs."
The UCEED page lists seven institutes for 2026-27: IIT Bombay, Delhi, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Roorkee and IIITDM Jabalpur, with 245 seats.
"Merchant Navy (Marine Engineering) is a non-engineering option."
B.Tech Marine Engineering is engineering. The non-engineering deck route is BSc Nautical Science or DNS.
"NEST's status is unclear."
NEST 2026 was held on 6 June with 257 seats at NISER and CEBS.
"Pilot starting salary is Rs 20 to 50 lakh."
We found no official or sampled source for a starting figure, so we print none. Ask any flying school for the actual first-year offers of its last batch.

blocks.heading: Multiplier Skill for Each Door
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The proof shelf and the multiplier skill for each door

rows: Design (UCEED, NID, NIFT)
A portfolio of process sketches, observation studies and one small real project with feedback.
Explaining a design decision in plain words, plus basic user research.
Statistics, maths, data (ISI, CUET BSc)
One real dataset analysed end to end, with a short written conclusion.
Programming in Python or R, and writing for people who are not maths students.
Architecture, law, IPM
Drawing sets and site notes, a legal explainer or moot record, or a business case write-up.
Costing and client communication.
IISER, NISER research
A short literature review and one small lab or computational project.
Scientific writing and basic coding.
Pilot, deck officer, NDA
A passed medical, a fitness log, and clear scores on the specific written tests.
Stress handling and clear radio-style communication.
Design (UCEED, NID, NIFT)
Now: faster first drafts and mood boards. Later: more of the routine layout and production work is automated, so taste and problem framing carry the value.
Statistics, maths, data (ISI, CUET BSc)
Now: help with code and first-pass charts, which you must check. Later: routine reporting shrinks, and judgment on what the numbers mean stays paid.
Architecture, law, IPM
Now: research summaries and rendering help. Later: drafting gets cheaper, so licence, site judgment and accountable advice matter more.
IISER, NISER research
Now: literature search and code help, always verified. Later: routine analysis is automated, so question choice is the skill.
Pilot, deck officer, NDA
AI risk is low in the near term. Use it for study planning and practice questions, not for the medical or the fitness work.
